title: The shortcut that ate the morning

lines.text: A man in a hurry took a shortcut to beat the traffic, and it cost him the whole morning.
The main street was packed. Buses, cars, one slow delivery truck.
So he turned left, down an empty road nobody used.
Ten minutes later, the road ended at a farm gate.
A farmer looked at him. Then at his car. Then at the long way back.
He paid the farmer to open the gate, and the gate led to another gate.
Each one saved him a minute. Each one cost him ten.
By the time he reached the highway, the traffic had cleared.
Same street. Same bus. He was now two hours late.
Shortcuts feel fast because you only count the minute you saved. Comment ROUTE.
